metadata.title: Zero-Trust Cloud Modernization & Distributed Resilience
metadata.author: Chief Cloud Architect
metadata.targetAudience: VP of Infrastructure, Security Council, and Lead Architects

slides.title: Zero-Trust Cloud Modernization & Distributed Resilience
slides.subtitle: Migrating Legacy Monoliths to an Event-Driven, Multi-Region Service Mesh with Continuous Verification

talkingPoints: Open the architecture review with the strategic mandate: moving beyond perimeter defense to identity-centric continuous verification.
Frame the discussion around cost efficiency, 99.999% availability, and automated failover.
notes.transition: Let's review the strategic agenda for this architecture review.

slides.title: The Strategic Imperative: Quantifying Resiliency & Security
slides.subtitle: Baseline measurements from our 2026 enterprise cloud readiness audit
slides.statLabel: Target Annual Service Availability Across 3 Active Regions
slides.contextSentence: Zero-trust service mesh architecture with automated multi-region traffic routing eliminates single points of failure.

supportingMetrics.label: RTO / Failover
supportingMetrics.detail: Automated DNS steering and state synchronization enable regional evacuation within 30 seconds.

supportingMetrics.label: mTLS Coverage
supportingMetrics.detail: Every internal microservice hop encrypted and authenticated with SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identities.

supportingMetrics.label: Cost Optimization
supportingMetrics.detail: Graviton ARM instances and dynamic pod autoscaling yield immediate infrastructure savings.

talkingPoints: Emphasize that zero-trust is not just security; it standardizes telemetry and network efficiency across all clusters.

slides.title: Multi-Region Distributed Mesh Architecture
slides.subtitle: Global anycast edge routing down to isolated sovereign data planes
slides.keyInsight: Identity is the perimeter: all inter-service communications require ephemeral cryptographic tokens validated at every network hop.

talkingPoints: Walk through the edge, mesh, and persistence layers.
Show how CockroachDB and Kafka cross-region replication maintain data integrity even during total datacenter loss.

slides.title: Architecture Board Strategic Recommendations
slides.subtitle: Actionable rollout timeline for engineering directorates

takeaways.title: Phase 1: Identity & mTLS Baseline
takeaways.action: Deploy SPIRE identity agents to all 12 Kubernetes clusters by the end of Q1.

takeaways.title: Phase 2: Active-Active Data Plane
takeaways.action: Complete CockroachDB multi-region pilot for core transaction services in Q2.

takeaways.title: Phase 3: Chaos Engineering & Automated Failover
takeaways.action: Execute monthly simulated region blackout drills to validate the 30-second RTO guarantee.

slides.callToAction: Architecture Board vote scheduled for November 15: approval for Phase 1 capital allocation.

talkingPoints: Request formal sign-off from the Security Council and VP of Infrastructure.
